description: Lossless editing JSON contract for com3d2.anm.

BoneCurves.description: The ordered bone-path and property-curve records applied to an AnimationClip.
BoneCurves.title: Bone curve records
BoneCurves.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use valid bone paths and property indices; preserve keyframe order and channel identity.
BoneCurves.x-meido-game-usage: The loader maps each property index to a Unity local position or rotation channel.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The animation loader validates CM3D2_ANIM, maps property bytes to Unity AnimationCurve channels, and applies the curves to bone paths.

BustKeyLeft.description: Whether left-bust channels are enabled when supported by the file version.
BustKeyLeft.title: Left bust animation switch
BustKeyLeft.x-meido-edit-guidance: Change only when the corresponding channels are present.
BustKeyLeft.x-meido-game-usage: PhotoMotionData and the animation loader use this flag to include or suppress left-bust motion.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The animation loader validates CM3D2_ANIM, maps property bytes to Unity AnimationCurve channels, and applies the curves to bone paths.

BustKeyRight.description: Whether right-bust channels are enabled when supported by the file version.
BustKeyRight.title: Right bust animation switch
BustKeyRight.x-meido-edit-guidance: Change only when the corresponding channels are present.
BustKeyRight.x-meido-game-usage: The loader applies the same gating to right-bust channels.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The animation loader validates CM3D2_ANIM, maps property bytes to Unity AnimationCurve channels, and applies the curves to bone paths.

Version.description: The version controlling optional bust-key flags.
